the performance of DTNs routing protocols under different buffer management policies and mobility models.
the performance evaluation of DTN routing algorithms under different mobility models and buffer management policies.
the effect of buffer size, queuing mechanism, and mobility model on the performance of epidemic protocol.

the performance of the DTN routing protocol depends on the combination of mobility models with the queue management policy.

DLA and DOA buffer management policy with mobility models have a positive effect on delivery probability of DTN routing protocol.
the performance of epidemic protocol is greatly improved with the help of DLA and DOA buffer management policy.
